notes.title: Post-Release Content Update (06/01)
notes.content:
[h1]KANAPOCALYPSE Update (06/01/20)[/h1]

* Added [b]Kana sounds[/b] to the game ([i]questions and answers now play kana sounds[/i])
* Added a new [b]Random [/b]button in level selection screen
* Added [b]more Bears[/b] positions hidden on each levels
* Added more funny death texts on death screen
* Fixed music and kana sounds volume based on player settings
* Fixed shop weapon's background transparency
* Fixed victory / death screen button texts

[h2]Enjoy Kanapocalypse ![/h2]
